Every surface in this package is final
  • FINAL — scenes — 210 scenes (150 navtest scored with v1 PDMS, 60 navhard with v2 EPDMS), trajectories drawn per method
  • FINAL — navtest v1 PDMS distributions — 8 charts, one per method

This banner is derived from the files on disk at build time, not from a hand-set flag.

Scenes

Every scene in the split, listed top to bottom, strictly best score to worst, each with its own clip and score table. Tick which trajectories draw; the tick applies to every scene at once. navtest scenes score against v1 PDMS (6 subscores); navhard scenes score against v2 EPDMS (9 subscores) — the columns switch with the split and never mix. Each clip composites a camera panel (left) and a top-down BEV panel (right); trajectories are drawn on separate overlays positioned over each. Clips load lazily as they scroll into view. The floating panel on the right jumps to a rank or score band.
